question: Why did the authors choose copper current collectors for the anode-free sodium cell?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%copper%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%cu %' OR lower(text) LIKE '%cu)%' OR text LIKE '%Cu%' ORDER BY page, id

runs.text: The authors did not use copper in this cell. Their anode-free design plates sodium in situ on an aluminum current collector with a carbon nucleation layer. They explain the choice directly:

runs.quote: Cu because it offers significant cost (∼3× cheaper) and weight

runs.text: The stated benefits are cost and weight: aluminum is

The authors also mention earlier work that used Cu electrodes and reported higher voltage hysteresis at high current, which they used as a performance comparison rather than as a reason for their own choice:
